creatures.name: Click beetle firefly
creatures.fact: The two green lights on its thorax help it find other fireflies in the dark.

creatures.name: Moth
creatures.fact: It flies at night guided by the moon and stars, and smells flowers with its feathery antennae.

creatures.name: Cricket
creatures.fact: It's me, Paquito! Crickets sing at night by rubbing our wings, to find a mate.

creatures.name: Orb-weaver spider
creatures.fact: Many spiders weave their web at dusk to catch insects that fly at night.

creatures.name: Hercules beetle
creatures.fact: One of the biggest beetles in the world. It comes out at night to look for ripe fruit.

creatures.name: Frog
creatures.fact: It isn't an insect, but it's a night neighbor: it sings by the pond and eats lots of mosquitoes.
